e: Biology is the Science of Life. Biology systematically studies plants, animals, and microorganisms. History is not Science.

q: Morphology is the study of _____ and form.
e: Morphology is the study of structure and form. Structure is the form and arrangement of parts in an organism. Chemical is different: biochemistry looks at chemical substances and chemical processes in cells.

q: Cytology is the study of _____ structure.
e: Cytology is the study of cell structure. The cell is the basic living unit of structure and function. Tissue is different: histology is the study of tissues, a step above free cells.

q: Biophysics studies flight of bird or _____ in bats.
e: Biophysics studies flight of bird or echolocation in bats. Bats use echolocation; biophysics studies that with the laws of physics. Biophysics applies physics to living processes, such as bird flight or bat echolocation. Digestion is not echolocation.
Biochemistry studies chemical substances in cells. Biochemistry looks at chemical substances and chemical processes in cells. Biological is not chemical.

Biogeography explains distribution through space and time. Biogeography tracks distribution of species through space and time. Biogeography explains how plants and animals are distributed through space and time. Heat and light is not space and time.
Biometry is Biology plus Statistic. Biometry is biology plus statistics. Biometry joins biology with statistics, not with physics. Chemistry is not Statistic.
Anatomy and Histology are pure science. Anatomy studies internal structure of organisms. Applied is not pure.

q: Biotechnology and Veterinary science are _____ biology.
e: Biotechnology and Veterinary science are applied biology. Biotechnology uses living systems in industry, medicine, and agriculture. Veterinary science restores and maintains animal health. Pure is not applied.

Agriculture breeds livestock for food. Agriculture and husbandry both serve food production, but they are different practices. Agriculture is crop farming; it is not the same as animal husbandry. Shelter is not food.
Weather changes are caused by global warming. Global warming is the rise in earth's temperature from extra greenhouse gases. Ozone layer is not global warming.

q: Over fishing and _____ lead to feeding problems.
e: Over fishing and deforestation lead to feeding problems. Deforestation removes forest and can wreck habitat and climate regulation. Urbanization is not deforestation.

Biology is a fundamental natural science. Natural classification tries to reflect real evolutionary relationships. Biology systematically studies plants, animals, and microorganisms. Formal is not natural.

q: Medicine restores and maintains _____ in humans.
e: Medicine restores and maintains health in humans. Medicine and veterinary science restore and maintain health. Applied biology includes medicine, which restores and maintains human health. Strength is not health.

q: Animal husbandry is farming of crops and breeding of _____.
e: Animal husbandry is farming of crops and breeding of livestock. Animal husbandry raises livestock for food and other products. Animal husbandry is breeding and raising livestock, not growing crops. Wild animals is not livestock.
